text: Entry Requirements In order to be considered for admission, you must: -be a non-Chinese citizen, 18-45 years old, in good health, -have completed senior high school education or will receive a high school diploma by the summer before matriculation at SUFE in September 2026, AND -be a native English speaker or meet the English language requirement through one of the following English skill test scores: IELTS: 6.0 or above TOEFL iBT: 80 or above Duolingo English Test: 100 or above.
